(1) Foster/UW 'Students on the Job Market' (2020-09-22): 14 candidates with no year and no destination; yearMeaning job-market, degree copied as 'PhC', program = area heading. (2) Kellogg 'Job Placement' page, 8 snapshots 2018-2025: year headings are placement years ('View job placements of doctoral students ... from 2008 - 2018'), so yearMeaning=placement; program = department heading (note the heading changed from 'Operations' to 'Operations Management' from the 2019 snapshot on, and a 'Financial Economics' section appears from 2023 with the page's remark that the program launched in 2018 and 2023 is its first graduating class); degree left null because the page says only 'doctoral students'. destination is the full placement string as written; position is filled only when that string begins with an explicit title (e.g. 'Postdoctoral Fellow, X'). Name qualifiers '(JD-PhD)' and '(Economics PhD student with Finance advisors)' and the Finance-list remark after Paolina C. Medina were moved from name/destination into note; nickname parentheticals were kept in names. Paolina C. Medina (2017) appears under both Finance and Managerial Economics & Strategy, and Mustafa Akan (2008) under both Managerial Economics & Strategy and Operations (asterisked footnote copied into note); both rows are kept per snapshot. The entry 'Miguel Angel Talamas Marcos - Inter-American Development Bank,' continues on the next line ('Washington, DC') in the 2022-2024 snapshots and was joined. 'No students on the job market' lines and the '2009-2017' range heading produce no rows. Later snapshots drop the oldest years and shorten some destinations (e.g. 'Foster School of Business, University of Washington' becomes 'University of Washington'), which is why counts differ by snapshot. 'loan Mirciov' and 'loannis (Yannis) Stamatopoulos' are copied as the page spells them (likely OCR-style l/I confusion for Ioan / Ioannis); 'Jingjing Zhang — McGill Universit' is truncated on the page from 2019 on. (3) Cincinnati Finance PhD 'Placements' page: all 6 snapshots list only four institutions with no names, so they are recorded as unreadable. (4) Cincinnati 'Finance PhD Graduates' table, 6 snapshots 2018-2024 with identical content (68 rows each, 1971-2014): columns Year | Student | Dissertation | Advisor(s) | First Job; yearMeaning=graduation (page is a list of graduates), degree PhD, program Finance, destination = the 'First Job' cell as written (null for the 7 rows whose cell is blank), dissertation and advisor(s) in note; HTML entities —/– in two dissertation titles were decoded. (5) UBC Sauder 'UBC PhD Alumni 1995' and 'UBC PhD Alumni 2000' pages, 2 snapshots each (identical content, 'Last Updated on 9/20/2017'): columns Name | Current University | Division. listedYear is the page's alumni year with yearMeaning=unstated (the page does not say whether it is the graduation year); program holds the Division code as written (FIN, MIS, OB, POL, ACC, MKT, IB/FIN, IB/MKT, TRA/SC, SC); the 'Current University' value is a current affiliation as of 2017, not a placement, so it is kept in note and destination is null; e-mail addresses printed on the page were not copied.
